name: Practice Wheel Interactive 3D Reconstruction
assumptions: Outer diameter interpreted from the visible drawing note as 6.60 inches.
The circular face uses 18 repeated radial features at 20 degree pitch.
The visible 5 degree notation is represented as a subtle rib sweep/twist.
Radial pockets are modeled as recessed surfaces under raised ribs for close-up inspection.
features: Raised central hub with bore and concentric boss detail
OBJ export from the procedural mesh

platform.runtime: Static HTML, CSS, and dependency-free WebGL 2 JavaScript
platform.interaction: Mouse/touch rotate, right-drag or shift-drag pan, wheel zoom
platform.optimization: Procedural mesh generation with indexed triangles and GPU buffers
